title: 四局 / 善房 / 茶房
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: 11 boxes stand in this compound, 11 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 绮春园 东南隅 四所
evidence.summary: Under Daoguang the four courts in the south-east corner served as quarters of consorts of former emperors. S01 labels a long block in that corner 四局, in a hand that miscopies other labels: 四所 is possible. Position and that likeness only.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 四局 / 善房 / 茶房.
